Section 16 (Ski Resort) is a null entry in her fill function: she has no ski date. Same 27-section layout as Shiori's and Yuko's files. Options and thought endings are even-length; with an odd-length name nothing follows {G} on its line (an option ending on the name shows a space before the bracket, accepted). Identical lines share one copy. Verified in DuckStation on forced dates (date_run.ps1 -Girl 3 -Version -1, hidden; docs/testing.md 'The other girls' dates'): meeting on time, Shopping, Botanical Garden, Library, Karaoke, Cinema, Beach (her Ski Resort section is null: forcing it returns to the title, as unpatched), each with its first choice, her reply and verdict, the player's answer and the way home. Checked only statically: other versions, later choices, moods, being late, natural triggers. Her date events are in ayako_events.json; the impression thoughts in date_shared.json.
